proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.asset: Ability is the capacity for performing a task.
proposal.hypothesis: Novel exploratory guess: a generic description of ability as task-performing capacity can yield completed games without supplied-engine searches despite the failure of cbe90458a394a's empty asset. The paired one-word label tests whether descriptive content is needed beyond a nonempty ability reference. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial, or errored games do not support it.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. A difference from the one-word candidate would be exploratory, not proof of a semantic mechanism.
proposal.ablation: Relative to the accompanying Ability. asset, insert only is the capacity for performing a task before its final period, keeping the opening, file location, remaining game text, and actor settings identical. Relative to cbe90458a394a, only asset content changes. File length and descriptive semantics change together; a favorable result would motivate controlled deletions rather than a causal or robustness claim. Asset has eight words and no trailing newline.

costs.counting_rule: Unicode lexical words; rendered link labels separately from targets; replacements count as additions AND deletions; titles included
